Match plant names against the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone

Source: R/match.R
WFO.match.Rd

Matches plant names, exactly or with fuzzy matching, against a static copy of the World Flora Online (WFO) taxonomic backbone, and replaces synonyms by their accepted names. Names are given either as full names (column spec.name) or as separate genus, species and infraspecific columns.

Usage

WFO.match(
  spec.data = NULL,
  WFO.file = NULL,
  WFO.data = NULL,
  no.dates = TRUE,
  spec.name = "spec.name",
  Genus = "Genus",
  Species = "Species",
  Infraspecific.rank = "Infraspecific.rank",
  Infraspecific = "Infraspecific",
  Authorship = "Authorship",
  First.dist = FALSE,
  acceptedNameUsageID.match = TRUE,
  Fuzzy = 0.1,
  Fuzzy.force = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.max = 250,
  Fuzzy.min = TRUE,
  Fuzzy.shortest = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.within = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.two = TRUE,
  Fuzzy.one = TRUE,
  squish = TRUE,
  spec.name.tolower = FALSE,
  spec.name.nonumber = TRUE,
  spec.name.nobrackets = TRUE,
  exclude.infraspecific = FALSE,
  infraspecific.excluded = c("cultivar.", "f.", "sect.", "subf.", "subg.", "subsp.",
    "subvar.", "var", "var.", "[infraspec.]", "fo.", "forma", "nothosubsp.", "nothovar.",
    "sect."),
  spec.name.sub = TRUE,
  sub.pattern = c(" sp[.] A", " sp[.] B", " sp[.] C", " sp[.]", " spp[.]", " pl[.]",
    " indet[.]", " ind[.]", " gen[.]", " g[.]", " fam[.]", " nov[.]", " prox[.]",
    " cf[.]", " aff[.]", " s[.]s[.]", " s[.]l[.]", " p[.]p[.]", " p[.] p[.]", "[?]",
    " inc[.]", " stet[.]", "Ca[.]", "nom[.] cons[.]", "nom[.] dub[.]", " nom[.] err[.]",
    " nom[.] illeg[.]", " nom[.] inval[.]", " nom[.] nov[.]", " nom[.] nud[.]",
    " nom[.] obl[.]", " nom[.] prot[.]", " nom[.] rej[.]", " nom[.] supp[.]",
    " sensu auct[.]"),
  verbose = TRUE,
  counter = 1000,
  cores = 1,
  Fuzzy.genus = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.transfer = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.one.strict = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.epithet.check = TRUE,
  Fuzzy.keep.genus = TRUE,
  Fuzzy.skip.placeholder = TRUE,
  spec.name.aff.genus = FALSE,
  spec.name.fix.encoding = TRUE
)

Arguments

spec.data

A data.frame with the names to match, or a character vector (or factor) of names, which becomes column spec.name.

WFO.file

Path to the backbone file (classification.csv), read with WFO.read(). Ignored if WFO.data is given. If both are NULL, the backbone at the location remembered by WFO.remember() or WFO.download() is read.

WFO.data

The backbone as a data.frame or data.table (from WFO.read(), WFO.remember() or WFO.backbone()).

no.dates

Deprecated and ignored (columns created and modified of the backbone are always left out of the results); giving it produces a warning.

spec.name

Name of the column with full plant names (without authors). If this column is absent, names are matched via Genus, Species, Infraspecific.rank and Infraspecific.

Genus, Species, Infraspecific.rank, Infraspecific

Names of the columns with the genus, the specific epithet, the infraspecific rank (such as "subsp." or "var.", as in column verbatimTaxonRank of the backbone) and the infraspecific epithet. Only used without spec.name; only exact matches are possible.

Authorship

Name of the column with the naming authors. If present, column Auth.dist gives the Levenshtein distance between the submitted and matched authors. As in WorldFlora, an empty author ("") gives the number of characters of the matched authors; use NA for unknown authors (distance Inf).

First.dist

If TRUE, column First.dist gives the Levenshtein distance between the first words (usually the genera) of submitted and fuzzy-matched names.

acceptedNameUsageID.match

If TRUE, replace matched synonyms by their accepted names (via acceptedNameUsageID), keeping the synonym in columns Old.*.

Fuzzy

Maximum distance for fuzzy matching, as argument max.distance of agrep(): a fraction of the length of the name (default 0.1), or a number of edits (1 or more). With 0, only exact matching is done.

Fuzzy.force

If TRUE, use fuzzy matching also for names that have exact matches.

Fuzzy.max

Maximum number of fuzzy matches; names with more are left unmatched, with their number in column Fuzzy.toomany.

Fuzzy.min

If TRUE, keep only the fuzzy matches with the smallest Levenshtein distance (utils::adist()) to the submitted name.

Fuzzy.shortest

If TRUE (and Fuzzy.min = FALSE), keep only the fuzzy matches with the most similar number of characters; this tends to remove infraspecific matches.

Fuzzy.within

If TRUE, keep only fuzzy matches that contain the submitted name (useful for names given as their first characters only); disables Fuzzy.min and Fuzzy.shortest.

Fuzzy.two

If TRUE and there were no fuzzy matches, try the first two words (genus and species) only.

Fuzzy.one

If TRUE and there were still no matches, fall back to the first word (genus) only. A genus found this way is reported as a fuzzy match. See Fuzzy.one.strict.

squish

If TRUE, remove repeated white space and white space at the start and end of names (as stringr::str_squish()).

spec.name.tolower

If TRUE, convert names to lower case, with a capital first letter.

spec.name.nonumber

If TRUE, names that contain numbers are interpreted as genera (only the first word is kept, without trailing digits). A morphospecies code at the end of a name (" sp.1", " sp.1_ECOSUR1", " sp9", " sp. 2") is removed first, so that "Aegiphila sp.1_ECOSUR1" gives Aegiphila (WorldFlora gave "Aegiphila1_ECOSUR").

spec.name.nobrackets

If TRUE, remove the part of names from the first "(" onwards (such as authors in brackets).

exclude.infraspecific

If TRUE, remove matches with an infraspecific rank listed in infraspecific.excluded (after replacement by accepted names).

infraspecific.excluded

Infraspecific ranks (column verbatimTaxonRank) removed by exclude.infraspecific.

spec.name.sub

If TRUE, delete sections of names that match sub.pattern, and "sp", "spp" or "indet" without a full stop at the end of a name ("Albizia sp" gives Albizia, not a species whose epithet starts with "sp").

sub.pattern

Regular expressions of sections to delete, such as " sp[.]", " cf[.]" or " nom[.] illeg[.]".

verbose

If TRUE, report details of fuzzy matching.

counter

Progress is reported every counter distinct names checked for fuzzy matches.

cores

Number of cores for fuzzy matching (parallel::mclapply(); not on Windows).

Fuzzy.genus, Fuzzy.transfer, Fuzzy.one.strict

Optional matching steps of WorldFloraFast for difficult names, described below. All are FALSE by default, which keeps the matching steps and the result columns of WorldFlora; they can be used together or separately. When one of them is used, the result has the columns Fuzzy.genus, Fuzzy.transfer and Fuzzy.alternatives.

Fuzzy.genus: if TRUE and the name was not found, match the genus first (genera that start with the submitted genus, or within the Fuzzy distance), then the epithet within these genera, ignoring Latin gender endings. Finds names with truncated or misspelled genera, such as "Reinwardtiod cinerum" (Reinwardtiodendron cinereum). Genera with similar names that are synonyms lead to their accepted genus, if the other genera give no match ("Parainarium excelsa" -> Parinari excelsa, via the synonym Parinarium). For a submitted genus that exists in the backbone, only genera of its family are considered. Also used, and preferred, when agrep() found the name only within names of unrelated genera (none starting with, or close to, the submitted genus): "Scab paphlagonica" is matched with Scabiosa paphlagonica rather than Festuca paphlagonica. Flagged in column Fuzzy.genus.

Fuzzy.transfer: if TRUE and the name was still not found, look for the same epithet (ignoring gender endings and -i/-ii) in other genera of the family of the submitted genus (the family of its accepted genus record). Candidates whose accepted taxon is in another family are ignored. A candidate is accepted (1) if exactly one accepted taxon among the candidates is, or has a synonym, in the submitted genus: the backbone shows that the species moved ("Chrysophyllum madagascariensis" is matched with Gambeya madagascariensis, a synonym of Gambeya boiviniana, which also has the synonym Chrysophyllum boivinianum); or (2) if all candidates lead to one accepted taxon and the epithet is distinctive, used by at most 50 accepted species in the backbone ("Lithocarpus acutissima" -> Quercus acutissima; "Endiandra bancroftii" -> Beilschmiedia bancroftii). Otherwise the candidates are listed in Fuzzy.alternatives. Flagged in column Fuzzy.transfer; please check such matches.

Fuzzy.one.strict: if TRUE, the genus-only fall-back of Fuzzy.one requires the first word to be, exactly, an accepted (not synonym) genus name. This prevents local names from being given a scientific genus, such as "Palma colorada" (Palma Mill. is a synonym of Phoenix) or "Cedro rosado" (fuzzy match with Cedrus). With FALSE, the fall-back of WorldFlora is used (any exact or fuzzy match of the first word). When the first word is a synonym genus and nothing is matched, its accepted genus is listed in Fuzzy.alternatives ("Altingia fargesii": Liquidambar).

Fuzzy.epithet.check

If TRUE (default), fuzzy matches found by agrep() for names of two or more words are kept only if (1) the epithet is within the Fuzzy distance of the submitted epithet, computed on the epithet alone (at least 1 edit, and 2 for epithets of 8 or more letters; a swap of two adjacent letters counts as one edit; gender endings ignored), or the submitted epithet is the beginning of it ("Quercus cornelius" -> Quercus cornelius-mulleri); and (2) its genus is the submitted genus, or a genus with a similar name in the same family. agrep() allows a distance relative to the whole name, so that without this check a short epithet can be replaced ("Ocotea luis" -> Ocotea lucida), and a name can be found within an unrelated longer name ("Inga ferrea" within "Coumarouna ferrea"). Rejected names are listed in Fuzzy.alternatives. This corrects matches of WorldFlora such as "Endlicheria dori" -> Endlicheria coriacea (now the genus Endlicheria); FALSE gives the results of WorldFlora. Names whose second word is a rank (genus and epithet written together, "Dichondramrepens var. sericea") are not checked, and an epithet written together with the next word ("australissubsp.") is accepted.

Fuzzy.keep.genus

If TRUE (default), a correctly spelled genus is kept: when the first word of a name of two or more words is a genus with species names in the backbone, fuzzy matches in other genera are not accepted. (A genus name without species, such as "Hyeronima", a variant of Hieronyma, does not keep its genus.) Matches in that genus are kept; if there are none, the genus-only fall-back (Fuzzy.one) gives the genus. "Ulmus parviflora" is matched with the genus Ulmus, not with Tamus parviflora (Dioscoreaceae); "Neea gigante" with the genus Neea, not with Leea gigantea (Vitaceae). This corrects matches of WorldFlora that replaced a correct genus by an unrelated one; FALSE gives the results of WorldFlora. The names that were not kept are listed in Fuzzy.alternatives when one of the optional steps below is used.

Fuzzy.skip.placeholder

If TRUE (default), names made only of placeholder words ("indet.", "sp.", "spp.", "cf.", "aff.", "unknown", and the words of sub.pattern) are not fuzzy-matched and remain unmatched. WorldFlora matched "indet." with Opuntia coindetti, in which "indet" occurs; FALSE gives the results of WorldFlora. With WFO.one(..., spec.name = "spec.name"), such names keep the submitted text.

spec.name.aff.genus

If TRUE, names with "aff." (affinis, near but not this species, as in "Drypetes aff. amazonica") are reduced to the genus. FALSE (default) removes "aff." with sub.pattern and matches the species, as in WorldFlora. Give the same value to WFO.prepare() and WFO.match(): WFO.prepare() already removes "aff." from the names it returns.

spec.name.fix.encoding

If TRUE (default), repair names garbled by a wrong character encoding (UTF-8 text read as Mac Roman or Windows-1252, up to four times: "Abies holoph‚Äö√..." gives "Abies holophylla", "Citrus √ó aurantium" gives "Citrus × aurantium"), and replace Cyrillic letters that look like Latin ones in names that also contain Latin letters. Accented text ("Allemão") is not changed. FALSE gives the results of WorldFlora.

Value

A data.frame with the columns of spec.data, followed by:

spec.name.ORIG, Squished, Brackets.detected, Number.detected

Original names and the cleaning steps applied (with spec.name only).

Unique

TRUE if there was one match (or none).

Matched

TRUE if a match was found.

Fuzzy

TRUE if the match was found by fuzzy matching.

Fuzzy.toomany

Number of fuzzy matches if more than Fuzzy.max (else FALSE).

Fuzzy.two, Fuzzy.one

TRUE if matching was tried with the first two words or the first word.

Fuzzy.genus, Fuzzy.transfer

TRUE if the match was found by the genus-then-epithet step or the genus-transfer step. Only when one of the optional steps is used.

Fuzzy.alternatives

Names that were not accepted but may have been meant (at most five species, with the total in brackets): fuzzy matches in another family than the submitted genus, and the candidates of an ambiguous genus transfer. Empty otherwise. Only when one of the optional steps is used.

Fuzzy.dist

Levenshtein distance between the submitted name and the name that was matched (for replaced synonyms, Old.name).

Auth.dist

Levenshtein distance between submitted and matched authors (with Authorship; Inf when it cannot be calculated).

First.dist

Distance between the first words (with First.dist = TRUE).

OriSeq

Row number of the submitted name in spec.data.

Subseq

Number of the candidate for the submitted name.

taxonID ...

The columns of the backbone for the match (empty or NA when unmatched).

Hybrid

"×" if the matched name is a hybrid.

New.accepted

TRUE if the match was a synonym that was replaced by its accepted name.

Old.status, Old.ID, Old.name, Old.author

Status, ID, name and authors of the replaced synonym.

Old.author.dist

Distance between submitted authors and those of the synonym, as text ("" where no synonym was replaced), as in WorldFlora.

Existing columns of spec.data with these names are renamed with suffix .ORIG.

Details

Preparation of names. When spec.name is used, names are first cleaned in this order: squish, spec.name.tolower, spec.name.sub, spec.name.nobrackets, spec.name.nonumber; finally " x " is read as hybrid notation and replaced by " ×". The submitted names are kept in column spec.name.ORIG, and columns Squished, Brackets.detected and Number.detected show what was changed.

Matching. Names are matched in this order, each step only for names that the previous steps did not match:

  1. exact matches (hybrid notation does not matter: "Mentha x piperita", "Mentha ×piperita" and "Mentha × piperita" are the same name);

  2. conserved alternative family names (Compositae, Leguminosae, Umbelliferae, Palmae, Cruciferae, Guttiferae, Labiatae, Gramineae) not in the backbone, matched with their standard names (Asteraceae, Fabaceae, ...);

  3. fuzzy matches of the full name with agrep(), then of its first two words (Fuzzy.two), restricted to a correctly spelled genus (Fuzzy.keep.genus) and checked by Fuzzy.epithet.check; names that are only placeholders are skipped (Fuzzy.skip.placeholder);

  4. genus then epithet (Fuzzy.genus, optional), also when the fuzzy matches of the previous step all belong to unrelated genera; if the submitted genus exists in the backbone and these matches are all in other families, they are not accepted ("Schizolobium robustum" is not matched with Schizoglossum robustum, Apocynaceae) but listed in Fuzzy.alternatives;

  5. same epithet in another genus of the family (Fuzzy.transfer, optional);

  6. the genus only (Fuzzy.one; restricted by the optional Fuzzy.one.strict).

Fuzzy candidates are reduced by Fuzzy.within, Fuzzy.min or Fuzzy.shortest. Submitted names with several matches get several rows, numbered by Subseq; WFO.one() then keeps one row per submitted name.

What fuzzy matching cannot do. agrep() finds the submitted name within longer names, which is how incomplete names such as "Pygeum afric" are found, but it can also produce matches for local names ("Palo blanco" is within two edits of part of "Tribulago blancoi"); such matches have a large Fuzzy.dist compared with the length of the name. Local names that are themselves names in the backbone (such as the genus Guayaba) are matched like any other name. Review fuzzy matches, and remove local names before matching where possible.

WFO releases. Both the conventions of WFO releases up to 2025 (ranks "SPECIES" and "var.", hybrids written "Mentha ×piperita") and those of the WFO Plant List 2026-06 onwards (ranks "species" and "variety", hybrids written "Mentha × piperita") are understood, for example in exclude.infraspecific and when matching by Genus/Species/Infraspecific.rank columns.

Speed. The backbone is indexed once per call, and fuzzy matching is done once per distinct name. Before each agrep() search, an exact prefilter removes names that cannot match: with at most k edits, at least one of k + 1 pieces of the submitted name occurs unchanged in every match (pigeonhole principle), so a fast fixed-string search for the pieces leaves few candidates. Results are identical to searching the whole backbone.

Differences with WorldFlora 1.14-5 are listed in the NEWS file: notably, Unique is FALSE for names with several exact matches, and conserved family names and unmatched names are no longer replaced by other records, and a correctly spelled genus is not replaced by another genus (Fuzzy.keep.genus), short epithets are not replaced (Fuzzy.epithet.check) and placeholders are not matched (Fuzzy.skip.placeholder); each of these corrections can be switched off. Results are unchanged otherwise: by default the result columns and their formats are those of WorldFlora, and the optional steps Fuzzy.genus, Fuzzy.transfer and Fuzzy.one.strict are switched off.

References

Kindt, R. (2020). WorldFlora: An R package for exact and fuzzy matching of plant names against the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone data. Applications in Plant Sciences 8(9): e11388. doi:10.1002/aps3.11388

See also

WFO.one() to keep one match per name, WFO.prepare() to separate names and authors, WFO.spelling.check() to check fuzzy matches.

Examples

## ---- default settings (those of WorldFlora) ----
# WFO.example2026 is a small extract of the WFO Plant List 2026-06
data(WFO.example2026)
m <- WFO.match(c(
  "Faidherbia albida", "Acacia albida", "Pygeum afric", "Mentha x piperita",
  "Prunus sp."
), WFO.data = WFO.example2026)
#> pattern ' x ' was interpreted as hybrid notation and replaced by ' ×'
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 1 records
#> Fuzzy matches for Pygeum afric were: Pygeum africanum
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
m[, c(
  "spec.name", "Subseq", "Fuzzy", "Fuzzy.dist", "scientificName",
  "scientificNameAuthorship", "Old.name"
)]
#>           spec.name Subseq Fuzzy Fuzzy.dist     scientificName
#> 1 Faidherbia albida      1 FALSE         NA  Faidherbia albida
#> 2     Acacia albida      1 FALSE         NA  Faidherbia albida
#> 3     Acacia albida      2 FALSE         NA Vachellia tortuosa
#> 4     Acacia albida      3 FALSE         NA      Acacia albida
#> 5      Pygeum afric      1  TRUE          4    Prunus africana
#> 6  Mentha ×piperita      1 FALSE         NA  Mentha × piperita
#> 7            Prunus      1 FALSE         NA             Prunus
#>   scientificNameAuthorship         Old.name
#> 1         (Delile) A.Chev.                 
#> 2         (Delile) A.Chev.    Acacia albida
#> 3   (L.) Seigler & Ebinger    Acacia albida
#> 4             Rojas Acosta                 
#> 5        (Hook.f.) Kalkman Pygeum africanum
#> 6                       L.                 
#> 7                       L.                 
# one match per name, with the default criteria of WFO.one()
WFO.one(m)[, c(
  "spec.name", "scientificName", "scientificNameAuthorship",
  "One.Reason"
)]
#> Different candidates for original record # 2, including Faidherbia albida
#> Found unique not a synonym case for record # 2
#>           spec.name    scientificName scientificNameAuthorship    One.Reason
#> 1 Faidherbia albida Faidherbia albida         (Delile) A.Chev.              
#> 4     Acacia albida     Acacia albida             Rojas Acosta Not a synonym
#> 5      Pygeum afric   Prunus africana        (Hook.f.) Kalkman              
#> 6  Mentha ×piperita Mentha × piperita                       L.              
#> 7            Prunus            Prunus                       L.              

# names in separate columns
WFO.match(data.frame(
  Genus = "Gambeya", Species = "boiviniana", Infraspecific.rank = "",
  Infraspecific = ""
), WFO.data = WFO.example2026)$scientificName
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
#> [1] "Gambeya boiviniana"

## ---- non-default settings, marked "non-default" ----
# homonyms of "Acacia albida": the authors decide which one was meant
aa <- data.frame(
  spec.name = "Acacia albida",
  Authorship = c("Delile", "Lindl.", "")
)
m <- WFO.match(aa,
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026,
  verbose = FALSE
) # non-default: no messages
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
WFO.one(m,
  Auth.dist = "Auth.dist", Old.author.dist = "Old.author.dist", # non-default
  verbose = FALSE
)[, c("Authorship", "scientificName", "Old.name", "One.Reason")]
#>   Authorship     scientificName      Old.name                        One.Reason
#> 1     Delile  Faidherbia albida Acacia albida Authorship best match for synonym
#> 5     Lindl. Vachellia tortuosa Acacia albida Authorship best match for synonym
#> 7             Faidherbia albida Acacia albida                       smallest ID

# matching steps of WorldFloraFast for difficult names
x <- c(
  "Reinwardtiod cinerum", # truncated genus
  "Chrysophyllum madagascariensis", # species transferred to another genus
  "Palma colorada"
) # local name
m <- WFO.match(x,
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026, verbose = FALSE,
  Fuzzy.genus = TRUE, Fuzzy.transfer = TRUE, # non-default
  Fuzzy.one.strict = TRUE
) # non-default
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 3 records
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
m[, c(
  "spec.name", "Matched", "Fuzzy.genus", "Fuzzy.transfer",
  "scientificName", "Old.name"
)]
#>                        spec.name Matched Fuzzy.genus Fuzzy.transfer
#> 1           Reinwardtiod cinerum    TRUE        TRUE          FALSE
#> 2 Chrysophyllum madagascariensis    TRUE       FALSE           TRUE
#> 3                 Palma colorada   FALSE       FALSE          FALSE
#>                scientificName                 Old.name
#> 1 Reinwardtiodendron cinereum                         
#> 2          Gambeya boiviniana Gambeya madagascariensis
#> 3                        <NA>                         
# with the default settings, these names are matched with genera only
m0 <- WFO.match(x, WFO.data = WFO.example2026, verbose = FALSE)
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 3 records
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
WFO.one(m0)$scientificName
#> Different candidates for original record # 1, including Saurauia
#> Found unique not a synonym case for record # 1
#> [1] "Reinwardtia"   "Chrysophyllum" "Phoenix"      

# all fuzzy candidates, then one match per name
e1 <- WFO.match("Omalanthus populneus",
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026,
  Fuzzy.min = FALSE, verbose = FALSE
) # non-default
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 1 records
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
e1[, c(
  "Subseq", "Fuzzy.dist", "scientificName", "taxonomicStatus",
  "Old.name"
)]
#>   Subseq Fuzzy.dist         scientificName taxonomicStatus
#> 1      1          2  Homalanthus populneus        Accepted
#> 2      2          2  Homalanthus populneus       Unchecked
#> 3      3         19 Homalanthus caloneurus        Accepted
#> 4      4         16  Homalanthus populneus        Accepted
#> 5      5         14  Homalanthus populneus        Accepted
#> 6      6         13  Homalanthus populneus        Accepted
#> 7      7         14        Alchornea sicca        Accepted
#>                                 Old.name
#> 1                                       
#> 2                                       
#> 3 Homalanthus populneus var. cordifolius
#> 4    Homalanthus populneus var. genuinus
#> 5      Homalanthus populneus var. laevis
#> 6       Homalanthus populneus var. minor
#> 7      Homalanthus populneus var. siccus
o1 <- WFO.one(e1, verbose = FALSE)
o1[, c("spec.name", "scientificName", "One.Reason")]
#>              spec.name        scientificName    One.Reason
#> 1 Omalanthus populneus Homalanthus populneus Not a synonym

# names in capitals
WFO.match("FAIDHERBIA ALBIDA",
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026,
  spec.name.tolower = TRUE, verbose = FALSE
)$scientificName # non-default
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
#> [1] "Faidherbia albida"

# exclusion of infraspecific matches: 0 rows, the variety is excluded
nrow(WFO.match("Gambeya boiviniana var. lavanchiana",
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026,
  acceptedNameUsageID.match = FALSE, # non-default
  exclude.infraspecific = TRUE, # non-default
  verbose = FALSE
))
#> [1] 0
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
WFO.download() # complete backbone, available as WFO.data
WFO.match(c("Acacia nilotica", "Coffea arabika"),
  WFO.data = WFO.data,
  cores = 4
) # non-default
} # }
